$comment: Choreography plan for scripts/build-routines.ts. The builder measures each pool clip's own beat, then makes `variations` random dances per song from the pool: each phrase starts on a song beat, on one of the clip's steps, played at the speed that puts the clip's steps on the song's beats. The booth plays a different dance each session. Keep the pool to simple moves anyone can copy (no hip-hop isolations, fast footwork, squats or turning away from the camera). Pool entries are a clip name or {clip, weight}; a higher weight makes a clip come up more often. Clip names from FBX files are the file name without extension; list every file used in clipFiles. If a clip's beat is measured wrong, set it in beatOverrides: {"clip": {"beatSec": 0.5, "downbeatSec": 0.1, "loops": false}} (loops = the clip is a seamless loop of whole beats). After changing clips, `pnpm assets:prune` removes animation files no longer listed.
